english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for someone who is careless or heedless.
This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is careless, inattentive, or forgetful about things needing care.
Use this as the all-purpose rendering for being careless or failing to pay attention.

examples.english: You're so thoughtless that you even forgot to lock the door.
They are neglectful and often forget to turn off the stove before leaving.
examples.traditional: 佢成日粗心大意，出門口唔記得熄火。

examples.english: You were negligent in your work and left several pages out of the report.
examples.traditional: 你做嘢粗心大意，份報告漏咗幾頁。
